subject_group: 17.2.3 Armament and stores electromagnetic environmental effects

versions.text:
Standard: Store can safely operate (e.g., inventory, carriage, employment, and jettison) and does not cause a hazard (e.g., unintentional detonation, release, or FOD) to the air system when exposed to direct and indirect effects of lightning IAW MIL-STD-464, Lightning paragraph. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Examination.
(1) Review grounding and bonding specification documentation, drawings, and manufacturing bonding process for verification of mechanical interfaces to the store and air system. Analysis.
  (1) Conduct air system lightning zoning analysis to include external stores. Identify applicable lightning threat levels to be assessed for store testing. Test.
    (1) Lab test: Conduct direct effects lightning testing on store radome or non-conductive surfaces (if applicable), skin or panel, and variable or fixed control surface representative coupons.
    (2) Ground test: Take store bonding measurements as installed on the air system to verify bonding performance requirements for applicable mechanical interfaces. Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Test.
    (3) Lab test: For external fuel tanks, ensure ignition sources are eliminated by conducting high current testing on fuel system representative components IAW SAE ARP5416B Ignitable Mixture (Flammable Gas) Test Method paragraph or an equivalent, such as the RTCA DO-160 Ignitable Mixture (Flammable Gas) Test Method.
    (4) Ground test: Conduct a passive store, installed on air system or wing mockup, high-level lightning test or low-level CW test. Conduct post-test analysis to extrapolate current and voltage measurements to the applicable waveforms and threat levels to be assessed for additional testing. Alternatively, if the store has previously operated and been employed on a similar mission type air system that was previously tested to the specified lightning requirements, a similarity analysis may be conducted, provided the configurations are comparable.
    (5) Ground test: Verify high-level lightning or low-level CW store test results show safety margin to prior subsystem MIL-STD-461 CS117 test results. If not, conduct active systems direct drive testing to store interfaces as installed on the air system or wing mockup to verify safety-critical systems can safely operate during the applied extrapolated lightning waveforms and test levels.
